concept: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: internal art-direction contact sheet for an advanced vertical motion-design ad about automatically assembling video, voice and captions. Create ONE landscape 3-panel concept board, three equal tall portrait panels side by side, no text anywhere, no branding. Rich carefully art-directed 3D product campaign rendering, tactile and sophisticated, restrained deep petroleum blue/teal environment, coral enamel accents related to a red shirt, brushed aluminum, smoked optical glass, strong studio rim lighting and soft colored shadows. NOT neon cyberpunk, NOT white backgrounds, NOT generic dashboard cards. Each panel has a DIFFERENT visual metaphor, strongly legible at mobile size, with hero object occupying 65% of its frame. LEFT: exploded physical video cassette: three richly dimensional rectangular slabs hover aligned in depth, a photographic film ribbon, a sculptural audio waveform layer, an engraved text rail, all magnetically assembling into a single portrait frame, oblique camera, exceptional macro material detail. MIDDLE: a sculptural metallic precision aperture/pipeline junction, three physical media strips of teal, coral and pearl entering the mechanism from distinct depth planes then merging into one portrait-shaped output screen; compact editorial composition, tangible objects, no cables. RIGHT: a continuous coral film ribbon folds through space like a carefully choreographed sculpture, its transparent frames changing between photo, voice waveform and type bars; dark ocean-blue set, long directional lighting. Abstract pictures inside film should be muted grayscale architectural imagery, not people. Keep each visual understandable and beautifully proportioned. No labels, no letters, no fake interface, no watermark. Concept art only, not a storyboard with repeated panels.
